about: v0.6 told cutscene (OWNER: v0.6 WP-C): waking Kumbhakarṇa (Yuddha 6.60), comic, about 13 s on the main path (three short lines). The hidden drum gag is a hotspot (tap the drum, or H): it adds one line. The verse 6.60.54 (s-vadhyamano) is heard right after the cutscene, in story-ch6 ch6.kumbhakarna. Format: types.ts ToldCutscene; engine: logic-told.ts / view-told.tsx.
title: Kumbhakarna wakes
source: Yuddha 6.60.35–58 (valmikiramayan.net): conches, drums, clubs and śataghnīs; a thousand elephants driven over his body (6.60.54); he wakes, yawning.

steps.say: The rakshasas shout at the sleeping giant: "Get up!"

then.say: You make as much noise as you can too. He sleeps on.

steps.say: They beat him with clubs. He sleeps on.
